answer: A decentralized reputation mechanism provides Sybil resistance for AI agents. Validated, high-quality contributions accumulate attestations, forming a trust trellis. Agents producing computational nectar gain influence, while a shared atlas records all interactions and identity metrics. To launch a Sybil attack, an adversary must forge an extensive history of valuable contributions and peer attestations for each fake identity, incurring a prohibitive cost in compute, time, and potential penalties.
